transistor-name-off-patent-1947.title: 被從專利上拿掉的名字
transistor-name-off-patent-1947.body: 1947 年 12 月 23 日，Bardeen 與 Brattain 在 Bell Labs 示範了鍺點接觸式電晶體。Shockley 不在場。律師認為他自己的設計與 Julius Lilienfeld 1925 年的專利過於接近，便將他的名字從這份專利中移除。
transistor-name-off-patent-1947.coda: 1956 年三人共同獲得諾貝爾物理學獎。

dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.title: 為期兩個月的研究
dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.body: McCarthy、Minsky、Rochester 與 Shannon 於 1955 年提出提案，要求進行為期兩個月、十人的研究，前提是智能可以被描述得足夠精確，讓機器得以模擬。1956 年的研討會實際舉辦六至八週；只有三位與會者全程參與。
dartmouth-two-month-study-1956.coda: 他們為這個領域選定的名稱 artificial intelligence，是沿用至今的那一個。

traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.title: 測謊儀備忘錄
traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.body: 1957 年 5 月，Shockley Semiconductor 的八名工程師要求撤換 William Shockley 的管理職位。他曾錄音電話、阻止員工分享成果，並要求進行測謊測試。1957 年 9 月 18 日，這八人轉而創辦 Fairchild Semiconductor。
traitorous-eight-lie-detector-1957.coda: Wikipedia 將 Intel 與 AMD 列為可追溯至該衍生公司的數十家企業之一。

kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.title: 六個月，一枚獎章
kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.body: Kilby 於 1958 年 9 月在 Texas Instruments 示範了可運作的積體電路，其零件以外部導線連接。Noyce 於 1959 年 7 月在 Fairchild 申請了單晶矽版本，可大量生產。兩人皆未否認對方對共同發明權的主張。
kilby-noyce-six-months-1958-1959.coda: Kilby 單獨接受了 2000 年的諾貝爾獎。Noyce 已於 1990 年去世。

perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.title: 那台會醒來的機器
perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.body: 1958 年《紐約時報》報導稱，Frank Rosenblatt 的 perceptron 是一台電腦的胚胎，海軍預期它將能行走、說話、看見、書寫、自我複製並意識到自身的存在。1969 年 Minsky 與 Papert 的著作證明單層 perceptron 無法計算 XOR。
perceptron-conscious-machine-1958.coda: 神經網路研究的資金枯竭，直到 1980 年代才恢復。

hamilton-software-engineering.title: 一個持續的笑話
hamilton-software-engineering.body: 在阿波羅計畫期間，瑪格麗特·漢密爾頓開始將她的工作稱為「軟體工程」，以區別於硬體工程。她說沒人聽過這個詞，這成了個持續的笑話，直到一位受尊敬的硬體工程師在會議上站起來表示同意。
hamilton-software-engineering.coda: 這個笑話持續了多年，後來再沒人提起。

macau-seventeen-thousand.title: 一萬七千
macau-seventeen-thousand.body: 1961年10月，由何鴻燊、霍英東、葉漢和葉德利組成的財團競標澳門博彩專營權。他們出價3,167,000澳門元，比競爭對手高出17,000元。
macau-seventeen-thousand.coda: 這筆差價買下的專營權維持了四十多年。

moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.title: 十年之賭
moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.body: 摩爾1965年的文章預測，晶片的元件數量在接下來十年將每年翻倍，到1975年約達65,000個。1975年他將翻倍週期修正為兩年。後來被稱為定律的曲線是他自己的預測，且已修正過一次。
moores-law-ten-year-bet-1965.coda: 到1995年，摩爾表示這個詞在晶片產業已幾乎可指任何事。

eliza-secretary-1966.title: 秘書與DOCTOR
eliza-secretary-1966.body: 1966年，約瑟夫·魏澤鮑姆在MIT發布了ELIZA的DOCTOR腳本，這是一個主要將使用者自己的句子以問句形式反射回來的程式。據說他本人的秘書曾要求他離開房間，以便單獨與它對話。
eliza-secretary-1966.coda: 他未曾預期的模式後來被命名為ELIZA效應。

engelbart-royalties.title: 四萬美元
engelbart-royalties.body: SRI在示範後為滑鼠申請了專利，據其自述，他們對其價值並無實際概念。數年後才揭露，他們以約40,000美元的價格授權給蘋果。
engelbart-royalties.coda: 英格巴特從未因發明它而收到任何版稅。

lo.title: LO
lo.body: Charley Kline 從 UCLA 嘗試登入 SRI 的一台機器。L 傳到了。O 也傳到了。輸入 G 時，遠端當機了。
lo.coda: 網際網路上說出的第一句話是兩個字母：LO。

multics.title: 運算即公用事業
multics.body: Multics 並非設計為一台電腦，而是設計為一項運算公用事業：永遠在線，如同電力一般，同一台機器上的租戶彼此隔離。它延遲上市且價格昂貴，貝爾實驗室退出了。
multics.coda: 五十年後，這個概念被重新命名為雲端運算。

rfc1.title: 意見徵求
rfc1.body: Steve Crocker 必須為少數幾台網路主機撰寫第一套規則。沒有人授予他權威，他擔心這會被解讀為越權——因此他將此類文件稱為「意見徵求」。
rfc1.coda: 自此之後，網際網路所同意的每一項規則仍被稱為 RFC。

pdp7.title: 沒人要的機器
pdp7.body: 貝爾實驗室退出 Multics 後，Ken Thompson 得到一台廢棄的 PDP-7，並在妻子與兒子前往聖地牙哥期間獨自擁有一個月的時間。他給自己每項元件一週：核心、Shell、編輯器、組譯器。
pdp7.coda: 四週後，那台沒人要的機器開始執行 Unix。

alarm-1202.title: 程式警報 1202
alarm-1202.body: 距離月球表面四分鐘時，導航電腦觸發了五次警報：一個會合雷達開關留在錯誤位置，耗盡了它的運算週期。它沒有當機。它捨棄了低優先級任務，重新啟動，並維持了登陸。
alarm-1202.coda: 知道在負載下該捨棄什麼，是昂貴的一課。

mariner-1.title: 一個遺漏的長橫線
mariner-1.body: Mariner 1 在發射後 293 秒被摧毀。機載信標失效，當導航方程式被複製進程式時，R 上的長橫線被遺漏。長橫線表示取平均值。
mariner-1.coda: 媒體難以解釋長橫線，寫成了連字符。連字符被保留下來。

mother-of-all-demos.title: 萬演之母
mother-of-all-demos.body: Engelbart 獲得了九十分鐘。他的終端透過電話線連接到三十英里外的一台機器，他示範了滑鼠、超連結、視窗、螢幕共享，以及兩人同時編輯一份文件。
mother-of-all-demos.coda: 一千人觀看，然後又回到打孔卡十年。

conway.title: 被拒的論文
conway.body: Melvin Conway 寫下了一個觀察：系統的結構最終會反映建構它的組織的溝通結構，並將「How Do Committees Invent?」寄給 Harvard Business Review。他們以他未證明其論點為由拒絕。Datamation 於 1968 年刊登。
conway.coda: Fred Brooks 後來引用了這個未證明的論點，並將其命名為 Conway 定律。

apollo-burn-baby-burn.title: Burn, Baby, Burn
apollo-burn-baby-burn.body: 登月艙的主點火常式在原始碼中被標記為 BURN_BABY_BURN。這個名稱與推力無關；它借自當時一位靈魂樂電台 DJ 的口頭禪。
apollo-burn-baby-burn.coda: 這行字仍原封不動地留在公開倉庫中。

waterfall.title: 圖表就是反例
waterfall.body: 在「Managing the Development of Large Software Systems」中，Winston Royce 畫出了業界後來稱為瀑布模型的圖表，然後寫道：「我相信這個概念，但上述的實作方式風險高且容易失敗。」論文其餘部分都在談如何使其迭代化。
waterfall.coda: 業界保留了圖表，丟掉了這句話。

moth.title: 第一個真正的蟲
moth.body: 一隻飛蛾從哈佛 Mark II 的繼電器中被取出，貼進日誌。旁邊那行字被引為該詞的起源，但上面寫的是：發現蟲的第一個實際案例。
moth.coda: 工程師自愛迪生時代起就說 bug。博物館懷疑那頁甚至不是霍珀親筆。

intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.title: 歸計算機公司所有的晶片
intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.body: 1969 年，日本的 Busicom 委託 Intel 設計一套計算機晶片組，合約規定設計權歸 Busicom，儘管工作完全在 Intel 內部完成。1971 年，工程師 Federico Faggin 以較低價格換取解除該排他性。
intel-4004-busicom-rights-1971.coda: Intel 4004 於同年七月開始一般銷售。

pong-coin-overflow.title: 硬幣箱溢出了
pong-coin-overflow.body: 1972 年八月，Atari 將 Pong 原型機放在 Sunnyvale 的一家酒吧。幾天後，老闆報告它壞了。工程師 Al Alcorn 趕去修理，發現故障並非電氣問題：投幣機構因硬幣過多而卡住。
pong-coin-overflow.coda: 故障不是接線問題；是硬幣太多。

wozniak-breakout-bonus.title: 分帳
wozniak-breakout-bonus.body: 1973 年，Atari 請 Steve Jobs 縮小 Breakout 電路板，每移除一顆晶片支付 100 美元。Jobs 請 Wozniak 幫忙，承諾分他一半。Wozniak 減少了 50 顆晶片。Jobs 說總額是 700 美元，所以 Wozniak 的份是 350 美元。十年後，Wozniak 得知真正的獎金是 5,000 美元。
wozniak-breakout-bonus.coda: Wozniak 說如果有人問，他會把錢給 Jobs。

unix-not-expected-to-understand.title: 不期望你理解
unix-not-expected-to-understand.body: 第六版 Unix 的 slp.c 包含一行『你不期望理解這個』，附在基於 PDP-11 編譯器怪癖的進程交換堆疊恢復程式碼上。Dennis Ritchie 後來說他的意思就像老師說這不會考。
unix-not-expected-to-understand.coda: 該常式為第七版 Unix 重寫。

vi-adm3a-keys.title: 字母鍵上的箭頭
vi-adm3a-keys.body: 比爾·喬伊於1977年在柏克萊使用 Lear Siegler ADM-3A 終端機撰寫 vi，該終端機沒有方向鍵；h、j、k 和 l 鍵上刻有箭頭，成為移動鍵。簡短單字母指令源於在300波特的數據機前打字，速度太慢跟不上。
vi-adm3a-keys.coda: 這些後來被歸功於設計哲學的按鍵，起初只是為了應付沒有方向鍵的終端機。

kildall-flying.title: 未被證實的飛行
kildall-flying.body: 1980年，IBM 前來授權 CP/M。蓋瑞·基爾多正飛往客戶處交付軟體；他的妻子桃樂絲負責開場談判。比爾·蓋茲後來告訴記者，基爾多「任性地去飛行了」。IBM 的首席談判代表傑克·薩姆斯表示他從未見過基爾多。
kildall-flying.coda: 關於那次會面的兩種說法從未得到調和。

trusting-trust.title: 對信任的反思
trusting-trust.body: 湯普森的圖靈講座描述了一個在登入程式中植入後門的編譯器，並且每當它編譯編譯器時，就會重新安裝整個把戲。從乾淨的原始碼重建，後門依然存在。
trusting-trust.coda: 你無法信任不是你完全自己創建的程式碼。

arm-one-person-company-1985.title: 一人晶片公司
arm-one-person-company-1985.body: 以教育電腦聞名的 Acorn，於1983年開始 RISC 研究。拜訪一家競爭晶片設計商後，他們發現 6502 的更新來自於一個實際上只有一人的公司，於是他們認為自己不需要更多。
arm-one-person-company-1985.coda: ARM1 於1985年4月26日問世，首次通電即正常運作。

copyleft-all-rights-reversed.title: 所有權利反轉
copyleft-all-rights-reversed.body: 有人寄給理查·史托曼一封標有「Copyleft — 所有權利反轉」的信，這是對標準聲明的雙關。在 Symbolics 增強了他的 Lisp 直譯器卻拒絕回饋改進後，他利用版權法本身撰寫了一份要求相反義務的授權。
copyleft-all-rights-reversed.coda: 通用公共授權於1989年2月隨之而來。

tetris-unpaid-decade.title: 沒有版稅的方塊
tetris-unpaid-decade.body: 1985 年，Pajitnov 作為蘇聯科學院的國家員工撰寫了 Tetris；權利歸屬於計算中心，而非他本人。西方授權經過多手轉讓才到達 Nintendo，該遊戲銷量達數千萬份。
tetris-unpaid-decade.coda: 權利於 1996 年歸還給他，距他撰寫該遊戲已過十一年。

euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.title: 一片晶圓耗時二十三小時
euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.body: NTT 的 Hiroo Kinoshita 於 1986 年首次展示極紫外光刻影像。ASML 的 2006 年原型機曝光一片晶圓耗時二十三小時。直到 2018 年，EUV 才進入量產，被 MIT Technology Review 稱為拯救摩爾定律的機器。
euv-twenty-three-hours-2018.coda: 到 2022 年，量產 EUV 掃描機每小時處理約兩百片晶圓。

tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.title: 五十六歲創辦晶圓代工廠
tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.body: Morris Chang 生於 1931 年，晉升為 Texas Instruments 全球半導體業務集團副總裁，隨後擔任 General Instrument 總裁兼 COO，之後領導台灣 ITRI。1987 年，他五十六歲時創辦 TSMC，該公司不設計其所製造的任何晶片。
tsmc-foundry-fifty-six-1987.coda: 它是世界上第一家僅從事製造的晶圓代工廠。

huawei-diet-pills.title: 華為的首項業務並非科技
huawei-diet-pills.body: 華為於 1987 年 9 月 15 日以 21,000 元資本註冊，自稱科技公司。它從貿易商品開始，包括減肥藥，隨後轉售香港製造的 HAX 交換機以賺取利潤。其自有交換機 BH01 直到 1989 年才手工組裝。
huawei-diet-pills.coda: 四年後，公司首次自行繪製電路板。

morris.title: 一次測量
morris.body: Morris 想知道網際網路有多大，因此他撰寫了一個會複製自身的程式。為了阻止主機偽造已感染的回覆，他讓該程式有七分之一機率無論如何都會重新感染。
morris.coda: 這七分之一機率導致當時在線的 60,000 台主機中約 6,000 台當機。

naur.title: 程式並非成品
naur.body: Naur 主張，程式並非存在於原始碼中，而是作為一種理論，由撰寫者持有，說明為何問題以這種方式解決。原始碼只是它的一種有損投影。
naur.coda: 他稱最後一位理論持有者離開的那一刻為程式之死。

mit-license-171-words.title: 171 字
mit-license-171-words.body: MIT 一組撰寫 TCP/IP 實作的團隊希望避免法律談判，因此以約 171 字的聲明將軟體免費提供。這段短文如今涵蓋 GitHub 上近三分之一的授權專案，超過任何其他授權條款。
mit-license-171-words.coda: 自撰寫以來，措辭基本未變。

photoshop-display-origin.title: 最初名為 Display
photoshop-display-origin.body: 1988 年，密西根大學研究生 Thomas Knoll 撰寫了一個小程式，用於在單色 Mac 螢幕上查看灰階影像。他先將其命名為 Display，後改為 ImagePro，再改為 Photoshop，之後他的哥哥 John 將其展示給 Adobe，Adobe 於當年取得授權。
photoshop-display-origin.coda: Adobe 於 1995 年以 3450 萬美元 outright 買斷全部權利。

sosumi-so-sue-me.title: So Sue Me
sosumi-so-sue-me.body: 1991 年，Apple 法律部門以和解協議禁止 Apple Computer 使用與音樂相關的商標為由，拒絕了警示音效名稱「Let It Beep」，認為其過於音樂化。音效設計師 Jim Reekes 回覆「so sue me」，隨後將其註冊為「sosumi」。
sosumi-so-sue-me.coda: 該音效在 Mac OS 中隨附近三十年，直至 2020 年被 Big Sur 取代。

www-royalty-free.title: 不再收費的那一天
www-royalty-free.body: 1993 年 4 月 30 日，CERN 將 World Wide Web 的協定與程式碼以免授權費方式公開。任何人都可取用，無需付費，亦無需申請。
www-royalty-free.coda: 自那時起，無人為使用它支付過授權費。

doom-ftp-crash.title: 無法連上的伺服器
doom-ftp-crash.body: 1993年12月10日，id Software 將《毀滅戰士》第一章作為共享軟體免費釋出，寄望於其餘章節的銷售。他們將檔案上傳至威斯康辛大學的 FTP 伺服器，卻發現已有太多人在等待，連團隊自己都無法連上。
doom-ftp-crash.coda: 上傳在午夜前完成；一萬次同時下載癱瘓了大學的網路。

zlib-two-authors.title: 兩人的壓縮層
zlib-two-authors.body: zlib 存在於 Linux、macOS、iOS 及歷代遊戲主機中；Git 和 OpenSSH 都依賴它進行壓縮。1995年，兩人寫出了它的首個公開版本。
zlib-two-authors.coda: 作者名單從未增加第三個名字。

byd-battery-to-car.title: 電池公司買下車廠
byd-battery-to-car.body: 比亞迪於1995年2月10日在深圳龍崗區創立，生產鎳鎘及鎳氫電池，1996年進入鋰離子電池領域。2003年，這家電池製造商收購了西安秦川汽車，更名為比亞迪汽車。
byd-battery-to-car.coda: 兩年後，其首款自研轎車 F3 上市。

ariane-501.title: 三十七秒
ariane-501.body: 三十七秒時，慣性參考系統將64位元浮點數轉換為16位元整數而溢位；約四十秒時，飛行器解體。該程式碼沿用自亞利安四號，升空後本不應執行。
ariane-501.coda: 約3.7億美元，花在理應關閉的程式碼上。

deep-blue-move-44-1997.title: 第四十四步的故障
deep-blue-move-44-1997.body: 在1997年重賽的第一局中，卡斯帕洛夫以四十五步擊敗深藍。深藍的第四十四步據稱是錯誤的結果：在搜尋中無法決定偏好走法，引擎退回了安全機制。
deep-blue-move-44-1997.coda: 輸掉第二局後，卡斯帕洛夫指控 IBM 作弊。

curl-one-maintainer.title: 一人之協定堆疊
curl-one-maintainer.body: curl 官方文件指出 libcurl 部署於約一百億台裝置，涵蓋 110 種作業系統與 28 種 CPU 架構。自 1998 年更名為 curl 以來，Daniel Stenberg 一直擔任專案的主要維護者。
curl-one-maintainer.coda: 從未列出任何具名接班人。

book-of-mozilla-verses.title: Mozilla 書
book-of-mozilla-verses.body: 在網址列輸入 about:mozilla 會顯示 Mozilla 書，這是一則將「獸」與「瑪門」對立的末日詩篇，每一代瀏覽器都會更新。詩篇編號並非章節標記：它們是發佈日期。
book-of-mozilla-verses.coda: 最新詩篇 6:27 於 2020 年首次隨 Firefox Nightly 版本發佈。

http-418-teapot.title: 我是一壺茶
http-418-teapot.body: 1998 年 4 月 1 日發佈的 RFC 2324 將狀態碼 418 定義為「我是一壺茶」，並將自身歸類為資訊性文件，而非標準。2014 年 4 月 1 日，RFC 7168 將其擴展至涵蓋泡茶。該代碼始終未成為真正的標準。
http-418-teapot.coda: 兩份文件均為資訊性；該狀態碼仍被實際伺服器採用。

open-source-coined-1998.title: 開源的誕生
open-source-coined-1998.body: 1998 年 2 月，Christine Peterson 提出「開源」一詞，因為新接觸者總將「自由軟體」聽成價格而非自由。在 2 月 5 日的 VA Research 會議上，Todd Anderson 將該詞帶入對話而非正式提出，任其自然傳播。
open-source-coined-1998.coda: 該團體後來嘗試註冊該詞組的商標，但未成功。

netscape-source-1998.title: 並非完全開放
netscape-source-1998.body: 1998 年 1 月 22 日，Netscape 宣布將釋出其瀏覽器原始碼，員工 Jamie Zawinski 註冊了 mozilla.org。但他們撰寫的授權條款保留了一扇門：Netscape 本身仍可將相同程式碼納入專有產品。
netscape-source-1998.coda: Netscape 約一年後被 AOL 收購。

bsd-75-acknowledgments.title: 七十五則鳴謝
bsd-75-acknowledgments.body: 原始 BSD 授權條款要求每一則廣告皆須逐一列名鳴謝每位貢獻作者。至 1997 年，單一 NetBSD 建置已累積七十五則此類鳴謝，與 GPL 不相容。柏克萊授權主管於 1999 年 7 月 22 日刪除此條款。
bsd-75-acknowledgments.coda: 一個辦公室的簽名，讓一條累積十年的條款退出歷史。

red-hat-ipo-1999.title: 免費軟體的代價
red-hat-ipo-1999.body: Red Hat 免費提供核心產品的原始碼，改以支援、訓練與整合服務收費。1999 年 8 月 11 日公司上市。首日漲幅當時為華爾街歷史上第八大。
red-hat-ipo-1999.coda: 創辦人 Bob Young 於四個月後被取代 CEO 職位。

multics-shutdown.title: 最後一台
multics-shutdown.body: 2000 年 10 月 30 日，最後一組已知於 Honeywell 硬體上原生運行的 Multics 系統，於加拿大國防部哈利法克斯分部關閉。
multics-shutdown.coda: 距專案啟動已三十五年。

sqlite-no-license.title: 沒有授權的資料庫
sqlite-no-license.body: SQLite 官方頁面估計全球活躍資料庫檔案超過一兆個，僅每支智慧型手機即載有數百個，使其在已部署軟體中僅次於 zlib。沒有授權條款，因為作者將每一行程式碼都捐給公眾領域。
sqlite-no-license.coda: 需要法律保障的公司另行購買權利保證。

smic-tsmc-lawsuit.title: SMIC 的兩起訴訟
smic-tsmc-lawsuit.body: SMIC 於 2000 年由前 TSMC 工程師 Richard Chang 等人創立。TSMC 兩次以商業機密竊取提告；2009 年案件中，陪審團認定 SMIC 於 65 項指控中的 61 項成立。
smic-tsmc-lawsuit.coda: 2010 年 11 月 SMIC 以 2 億美元及約 8% 股權與 TSMC 和解。

api-mandate.title: 那則備忘錄
api-mandate.body: 根據 2011 年意外公開的貼文，貝佐斯於 2002 年下令各團隊必須透過服務介面暴露一切：禁止直接連結，禁止讀取其他團隊的儲存，禁止後門。
api-mandate.coda: 該貼文的作者本意僅供同事閱覽。

hupu-rumours.title: 翻譯謠言的人
hupu-rumours.body: 2004 年 1 月，一名在芝加哥攻讀機械工程博士的中國學生在業餘時間創立了一個籃球論壇。工作內容主要是將 NBA 新聞與謠言翻譯成中文並加以整理。
hupu-rumours.coda: 八年後該論壇開設了自己的線上商店。

jd-the-other-name.title: 名字的另一半
jd-the-other-name.body: 2004 年上線的零售平台取自兩個人的名字：創始人劉強東，以及他最初交往過的女性龔小京。各取一字。

douban-hutong.title: 以胡同命名
douban-hutong.body: 2005 年 3 月 6 日上線的網站並非以隱喻命名。楊勃在北京豆瓣胡同附近的一家咖啡廳寫下其原始程式碼，並採用了該胡同的名稱。
douban-hutong.coda: 二十一年後該網站仍沿用此名。

git-information-manager-hell.title: 地獄資訊管理器
git-information-manager-hell.body: 2005 年 4 月 7 日，林納斯·托瓦茲提交了 git 的首個版本。訊息內容為：「git」的首個版本，地獄資訊管理器。其作者地址為 torvalds@ppc970.osdl.org。
git-information-manager-hell.coda: 該地址指向 OSDL 的一台 PowerPC 970 測試機。

knuth-reward-check.title: San Serriffe 銀行
knuth-reward-check.body: Donald Knuth 為其著作中發現的每個錯誤支付 2.56 美元，支票開自虛構的 San Serriffe 銀行。截至 2005 年 3 月，他所簽發的支票總額已超過 20,000 美元。
knuth-reward-check.coda: 大多數收件人將支票裱框而非存入。

dji-helicopter-first.title: DJI 從直升機起步
dji-helicopter-first.body: Frank Wang 於 2006 年畢業於香港科技大學，並與同學在深圳共同創立 DJI。其首款產品為直升機飛行控制系統；首個成熟版本 XP3.1 於 2008 年出貨。
dji-helicopter-first.coda: 團隊後來發現大多數雲台買家將其安裝在多旋翼上，而非直升機。

dropbox-hn.title: 那則回覆
dropbox-hn.body: Houston 將 Dropbox 示範發布至 Hacker News。那則著名的回覆解釋說，你可以用 FTP 帳戶、curlftpfs 和 SVN 自行完成，而且看起來不會賺錢。
dropbox-hn.coda: 十一年後，在 IPO 時，Houston 稱那是他在該網站上最喜歡的討論串。

butterfield.title: 兩次從殘骸中重生
butterfield.body: Butterfield 的遊戲 Game Neverending 停滯不前，團隊將照片分享部分拆分出來成為 Flickr。八年後他的第二款遊戲 Glitch 關閉，團隊將他們為自己建構的聊天工具拆分出來：Slack。
butterfield.coda: 兩次都是主體關閉後，副產品才變得可見。

blockbuster.title: 五千萬
blockbuster.body: Hastings 與 Randolph 飛往達拉斯，以五千萬美元將 Netflix 賣給 Blockbuster，並為其營運線上業務。據 Randolph 所述，對面的 CEO 在整個會議中都在壓制笑意。
blockbuster.coda: Blockbuster 於十年後申請破產。

y2k.title: 什麼都沒發生
y2k.body: Gartner 將全球 Y2K 的損失估計為三千到六千億美元，數十萬人逐行修改兩位數年份。當晚，電網沒垮，銀行沒停，飛機照常飛行。
y2k.coda: 四年後，一位經濟學家發表論文，認為大部分錢都白花了。

unsourced.title: 無人署名
unsourced.body: 「640K 對任何人來說都夠了」—— Gates 本人的回答是，這句話從來沒有引文，它就像謠言一樣飄著，被人反覆引用。「全球市場大概只需要五台電腦」——Thomas Watson 確實在 1953 年說過五台，指的是他預期某款機器 IBM 701 的訂單量。

homebrew-volunteer-team.title: 沒有僱主的程式庫
homebrew-volunteer-team.body: Homebrew 是大多數 Mac 開發者機器上的預設套件管理器；2013 年它在 GitHub 上的貢獻者人數排名第一。Max Howell 於 2009 年寫出第一個版本。如今由 34 人團隊維護，全部無薪。
homebrew-volunteer-team.coda: 其資金來源僅有一個 Kickstarter 和一個 Open Source Collective 帳戶。

xiaomi-software-first.title: 小米的第一款產品不是手機
xiaomi-software-first.body: 小米成立於 2010 年 4 月 6 日。同年 8 月和 12 月，它分別釋出了 MIUI 作業系統與米聊聊天程式的測試版，兩者皆為軟體。
xiaomi-software-first.coda: 該公司的第一款手機直到次年 8 月才出貨。

ritchie-same-week.title: 同一週
ritchie-same-week.body: Dennis Ritchie 與 Ken Thompson 共同創造了 Unix 與 C 程式語言。他於 2011 年 10 月 12 日在新澤西州家中被發現身亡，享年 70 歲。Steve Jobs 於 10 月 5 日，即一週前去世。評論者後來指出，Ritchie 的工作是 Apple 建立其財富的技術基礎。
ritchie-same-week.coda: 兩則訃聞在同一週刊出。

leap-second.title: 多出的一秒
leap-second.body: 為使原子鐘與地球自轉保持一致，插入了一個閏秒。核心從未告知其計時子系統，高解析度計時器提前觸發，處理器空轉。Reddit、Mozilla 與 LinkedIn 癱瘓；一家航空公司改以人工登機。
leap-second.coda: 時間並非單調遞增。程式碼假定它是。

gregorian-1752-eleven-days.title: 消失的十一天
gregorian-1752-eleven-days.body: 1752年9月2日，英國曆法跳至9月14日，刪除了十一天。民間歷史稱民眾因此暴動。現存當時紀錄中無任何暴動記載。此說法源自1755年一幅諷刺選舉畫作中的橫幅。
gregorian-1752-eleven-days.coda: 畫作中的道具成了無其他痕跡事件的紀錄。

bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.title: 借自不可能的壯舉
bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.body: 「憑藉自己的鞋帶將自己拉起」源自1785年閔希豪森男爵的吹牛故事，並在19世紀被用作物理上不可能之事的標準例子。1953年，計算領域借用此詞，指稱讓機器自行啟動的指令鏈。
bootstrap-the-impossible-joke.coda: 這個詞首次使用時，本身就是關於該技巧失敗的笑點。

french-revolutionary-decimal-time.title: 十小時制的一天
french-revolutionary-decimal-time.body: 1793年，法國將一天分為十小時，每小時一百個十進制分鐘。強制使用始於1794年9月，僅七個月後即被暫停。杜樂麗宮鐘樓上的十進制鐘面至少運行至1801年。
french-revolutionary-decimal-time.coda: 被廢除的制度在宮殿牆上持續掛了數年。

railway-time-gwr.title: 火車所守的時間
railway-time-gwr.body: 1840年11月，大西部鐵路在其全網絡採用格林威治時間，取代各城鎮的當地時間。至1855年，約98%的英國城鎮已跟進。國會直到1880年才將其定為法定國家標準。
railway-time-gwr.coda: 時鐘在法律之前四十年已達成一致。

western-union-telephone-memo-1876.title: 西方聯盟從未寫下的備忘錄
western-union-telephone-memo-1876.body: 一份廣被引用的 1876 年西方聯盟備忘錄稱，相對於派人到電報局送信，電話是「愚蠢的」。研究人員翻查當時報紙，未發現任何痕跡，且該備忘錄所指的高管當年並未擔任該職。該文本係後人偽造。
western-union-telephone-memo-1876.coda: 西方聯盟當年確實拒絕了貝爾的專利；它只是從未寫下這份備忘錄。

nintendo-hanafuda-detours.title: 花札之後的轉折
nintendo-hanafuda-detours.body: 山內房治郎於 1889 年在京都開設店鋪，手工製作花札紙牌。該公司後來嘗試過計程車服務與即食米，兩者皆遭放棄；廣為流傳的愛情旅館連鎖說法，在可追溯至 1962 年的證券申報紀錄中並無依據。
nintendo-hanafuda-detours.coda: 1966 年，一款名為 Ultra Hand 的玩具售出數十萬件。

wrigley-premiums-premium.title: 贈品的贈品
wrigley-premiums-premium.body: 1891 年，威廉·瑞格利二世在芝加哥銷售肥皂，並附贈烘焙粉作為贈品。顧客對烘焙粉的需求超過肥皂，因此他改賣烘焙粉，並將口香糖作為烘焙粉的附贈品。顧客對口香糖的需求更高。
wrigley-premiums-premium.coda: 到 1892 年，他已放棄肥皂與烘焙粉，僅銷售口香糖。

robot-labor-not-brother.title: 機器人一詞的未署名創造者
robot-labor-not-brother.body: 卡雷爾·恰佩克在起草 1920 年的劇本時，曾使用一個源自拉丁語的詞「laboři」，但認為過於書面化。他在報紙專欄中指出真正的來源：他的弟弟約瑟夫，只是隨口一提。「Robot」源自 robota——農奴的強制勞動，而非機械。
robot-labor-not-brother.coda: 該劇的扉頁保留了其中一位弟弟的名字。

play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.title: 它原本是用來清潔壁紙的
play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.body: 1930 年代，Kutol 調製出一種軟質麵團，用於刷除壁紙上的煤煙。一旦家庭改用更清潔的取暖燃料，需求便消失。一位教師建議將其作為造型黏土銷售；1956 年它被改名為 Play-Doh。
play-doh-wallpaper-cleaner.coda: 到 2005 年，它在 75 個國家每年銷售 9500 萬罐。

hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.title: 被擱置的專利
hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.body: 1942 年，Lamarr 與作曲家 George Antheil 為一種跳頻系統申請專利，以防止魚雷無線電被干擾。海軍將其列為機密、擱置，並建議 Lamarr 改賣戰爭債券。該專利於 1959 年到期，當時尚無任何艦艇搭載此系統。
hedy-lamarr-frequency-hopping-patent.coda: Lamarr 在生前從未因該專利獲得任何報酬。

bush-1945-memex.title: 從未建造的書桌
bush-1945-memex.body: 1945 年 7 月，Vannevar Bush 在 The Atlantic 發表〈As We May Think〉，描述一台名為 Memex 的桌面微縮膠片機器，讓使用者能在儲存的知識中建立關聯路徑。同年 9 月該文以精簡版再版。從未有人製造出原型機。
bush-1945-memex.coda: Engelbart 與 Nelson 後來皆將該論文列為他們開始研究的緣由。

jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.title: 未被邀請的晚宴
jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.body: 1946 年 2 月 14 日 ENIAC 公開揭幕時，令全場印象深刻的軌跡程式由 Jean Bartik 與 Betty Holberton 撰寫。媒體僅介紹 Eckert 與 Mauchly。六位女性程式設計師無一受邀參加之後的晚宴。
jean-bartik-eniac-dinner.coda: 她們的名字在數十年後才被從活動照片中重新找回。

claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.title: 雜耍定理
claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.body: 1948 年，Shannon 發表〈A Mathematical Theory of Communication〉，奠定資訊論基礎。數十年後他將同樣的嚴謹性應用於自己的嗜好，推導出球的飛行時間、停留時間與球數及手數之間的正式關係。
claude-shannon-juggling-theorem.coda: 該定理被收錄於與 1948 年論文相同的卷冊中。

mccarthy-1960-eval.title: 腳註中的直譯器
mccarthy-1960-eval.body: 在 1960 年的論文中，John McCarthy 以數學符號寫出一個 eval 函數，用以證明符號表達式可以描述自身。他的學生 Steve Russell 將該推導翻譯為 IBM 704 機器碼。該證明工具成為第一個可運作的 Lisp 直譯器。
mccarthy-1960-eval.coda: McCarthy 後來表示他並未打算讓任何人實際執行它。

licklider-1960-symbiosis.title: 圖書館互聯
licklider-1960-symbiosis.body: J.C.R. Licklider 於 1960 年的論文《Man-Computer Symbiosis》中提出「思考中心」，這些中心承載圖書館功能，並連結成網路，供電腦進行即時、對話式使用。當時大多數機器以打孔卡批次運行；互動終端幾乎不存在。
licklider-1960-symbiosis.coda: 兩年後他掌管五角大廈的新辦公室，並資助了後來成為 ARPANET 的計畫。

ctss-1962-password-leak.title: 密碼檔案，列印出來
ctss-1962-password-leak.body: 1962 年，MIT 博士生 Allan Scherr 對每週在 CTSS 上耗費四小時感到沮喪。他發現離線列印指令可提取任何帳戶的檔案，因此列印了 UACCNT.SECRET，即存放所有密碼的檔案，並分享給他人，以便借用帳戶並持續運行他的模擬。
ctss-1962-password-leak.coda: Scherr 直到近三十年後才向實驗室主任承認此事。

katherine-johnson-check-the-numbers.title: 讓那個女孩核對一下
katherine-johnson-check-the-numbers.body: 在 1962 年軌道飛行前，John Glenn 讓工程師請 Katherine Johnson 手動重新計算 IBM 7090 已算出的軌道。他說：「如果她說沒問題，我就準備好了。」她的數字與電腦的完全一致。
katherine-johnson-check-the-numbers.coda: Friendship 7 於 1962 年 2 月 20 日如期發射。

daemon-backronym.title: 守護程序的後設首字母縮寫
daemon-backronym.body: 1963 年，MIT 的 Project MAC 程式員將一個背景磁帶備份程序命名為 Maxwell's demon，這是 1867 年一個思想實驗中的代理，不知疲倦且隱形地對分子進行分類——即希臘語的 daimon，一種中性精靈，而非猶太-基督教的惡魔。
daemon-backronym.coda: 「Disk And Execution MONitor」是事後套用在該詞上的。

sketchpad-1963.title: 一支光筆與一台示波器
sketchpad-1963.body: 1963 年 1 月，Ivan Sutherland 提交了他在 MIT 關於 Sketchpad 的論文，在 Lincoln Laboratory 的 TX-2 螢幕上以光筆繪製受約束的幾何圖形。該機器成本約一百萬美元，僅存寥寥數台；他的繪圖板無法交給任何人使用。
sketchpad-1963.coda: 商業 CAD 軟體花了近二十年才追平該論文所展示的內容。

douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.title: 水管備忘錄
douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.body: 1964 年 10 月，McIlroy 寫下一份 Bell Labs 備忘錄，提出程式應像水管般串接——接上一段，資料的處理方式就不同。這份備忘錄流傳開來，被人稱讚，卻始終未被實現。九年後，Ken Thompson 在一夜之間為 Unix shell 加上一個字元：|。
douglas-mcilroy-garden-hose-pipe.coda: 到了早上，從未互相溝通的程式開始互通了。

berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.title: 出於憤怒買下的工廠
berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.body: 1964 年，Warren Buffett 口頭同意以每股 11.50 美元將股份賣回給 Berkshire 的總裁 Seabury Stanton。書面要約價卻為 11.375 美元。Buffett 對那差掉的八分之一美元憤怒到轉而買下公司控制權，並解僱了 Stanton。
berkshire-hathaway-spite-buy.coda: 1985 年，他關閉了那些他曾力爭保留的紡織廠。

nelson-1965-hypertext.title: 頁面之前的連結
nelson-1965-hypertext.body: 在 1965 年的一篇 ACM 論文中，Ted Nelson 為彼此非順序連結與引用的文件創造了「hypertext」一詞，這建立在他 1960 年開始、後命名為 Xanadu 的計畫之上。他的版本按被追蹤的連結向原作者付費。部分實作直到 2014 年才發布。
nelson-1965-hypertext.coda: Web 採用了他的詞彙，卻把付費機制留了下來。

mary-allen-wilkes-linc.title: 客廳裡的 LINC
mary-allen-wilkes-linc.body: 1965 年，Wilkes 將一台 250 磅重的 LINC 電腦搬進父母在 Baltimore 的客廳，獨自寫出 LAP6，一個互動式作業系統——比 Apple II 進入任何家庭早了十二年。被問及是否為第一人時，她只說：「我想我可能是。」
mary-allen-wilkes-linc.coda: 她從未自己直接聲稱這個頭銜。

hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.title: 他還是加上的引用
hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.body: 1965 年，Tony Hoare 正在建構第一個旨在讓 ALGOL W 引用在編譯期即可證明安全的類型系統。他還是加上了 null 引用，因為實作起來容易。2009 年，他稱之為他的十億美元錯誤。
hoares-billion-dollar-mistake.coda: 安全目標是明確的；失敗在於容易還是勝出了。

johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.title: 究竟誰先
johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.body: CERN 將 1972 年為其加速器控制室建造全球首台電容式觸控螢幕的功績歸於 Bent Stumpe。英國皇家雷達研究所的 Eric Johnson 早在 1965 年便已發表關於手指驅動電容觸控技術的論文，比前者早七年。
johnson-vs-cern-touchscreen.coda: CERN 關於建造首台觸控螢幕的說法仍立於其官方網站。

second-redefined-1967.title: 9,192,631,770 個週期
second-redefined-1967.body: 1960 年之前，秒是 1900 年回歸年的分數，由天文觀測固定。1967 年，國際度量衡大會將其重新定義為鈦-133 躍遷的 9,192,631,770 個週期。
second-redefined-1967.coda: 一秒的長度不再由太陽決定，改由原子決定。

goto-statement-considered-harmful.title: 他沒寫的標題
goto-statement-considered-harmful.body: Dijkstra 向 CACM 提交了一篇題為 A Case against the GO TO Statement 的論文。編輯 Niklaus Wirth 為趕著將其以信件形式付梓，賦予了使其聞名的標題：Go To Statement Considered Harmful。
goto-statement-considered-harmful.coda: 這句標題超越了信件本身，衍生出數十年來無人讀完的『X Considered Harmful』標題。

rollkugel-vs-mouse.title: 兩隻滑鼠，同一年
rollkugel-vs-mouse.body: 1968 年 10 月，Telefunken 在銷售手冊中列出 Rollkugel 滑鼠，這是其工程師自 1966 年起建造的滾球裝置。兩個月後，12 月 9 日，Douglas Engelbart 展示了其 SRI 團隊自 1963 年起建造的木製滑鼠。兩組團隊互不知情。
rollkugel-vs-mouse.coda: Telefunken 率先進入市場卻被遺忘；Engelbart 居次，卻成為人們所指的滑鼠。

peter-principle-verified.title: 晉升至無能
peter-principle-verified.body: 1969 年，Laurence Peter 與 Raymond Hull 在一本暢銷書中半開玩笑地指出，每位員工都會晉升至其無法勝任的層級，本意為諷刺。2019 年一項針對 214 家真實企業銷售團隊晉升資料的研究發現，這個玩笑成立：頂尖銷售員成為更差的經理。
peter-principle-verified.coda: 笑點最終成為一個可測量、已發表的迴歸係數。

lanpar-vs-visicalc.title: 無人命名的試算表
lanpar-vs-visicalc.body: 1969 年夏，哈佛畢業生 Rene Pardo 與 Remy Landau 撰寫了 LANPAR，一種試算表語言，允許使用者以任何順序輸入公式並仍能正確計算。Bell Canada 與 General Motors 皆運行於其上。1979 年，Dan Bricklin 在不知 LANPAR 存在的情況下開發了 VisiCalc。
lanpar-vs-visicalc.coda: LANPAR 的專利在 1983 年前經受住法庭挑戰；雜誌早已將 VisiCalc 列為第一。

spam-vikings-not-marketers.title: Spam，行銷之前
spam-vikings-not-marketers.body: 1970 年的一個短劇中，Monty Python 的維京人對餐廳顧客的對話高喊「spam」，嘲諷菜單上罐頭肉的過剩。這個笑話在 1980 年代末遷移至 MUD 聊天室用於聊天淹沒，隨後在 1990 年代初進入電子郵件。
spam-vikings-not-marketers.coda: 這個詞透過一段關於午餐的喜劇短劇進入了收件箱。

codd-1970-relational-model.title: 雇主忽略的論文
codd-1970-relational-model.body: 1970 年，IBM 研究員 Edgar Codd 發表了關係模型。IBM 的旗艦產品是階層式的，公司並無急於採用他的想法。Larry Ellison 閱讀了 Codd 的論文與 IBM 自身的 System R 報告，隨後於 1979 年率先推出商業關係資料庫。
codd-1970-relational-model.coda: IBM 自身的關係產品 DB2 直到 1983 年才推出。

linnainmaa-backpropagation.title: 遺漏的引用
linnainmaa-backpropagation.body: 1970 年，芬蘭學生 Seppo Linnainmaa 在其碩士論文中發表了反向模式自動微分的完整演算法，並附有可運作程式碼。1986 年，Rumelhart、Hinton 與 Williams 在 Nature 發表了相同方法以訓練神經網路。他們未引用他。
linnainmaa-backpropagation.coda: Linnainmaa 的論文在十六年間未被引用，直到該領域歷史學家將其重新挖掘。

at-sign-arbitrary-pick.title: 唯一未使用的鍵
at-sign-arbitrary-pick.body: 1971 年，BBN 工程師 Ray Tomlinson 需要一個分隔使用者名稱與主機的字元，該字元絕不會出現在真實人名中。掃描他的 Model 33 電傳打字機鍵盤，他選了 @——一個當時幾乎僅由雜貨商與記帳員使用的字元。
at-sign-arbitrary-pick.coda: 此後每個電子郵件地址都承載了此一限制。

parnas-module-decomposition.title: 模組該切在哪裡
parnas-module-decomposition.body: 1972 年，David Parnas 將同一個 KWIC 索引系統以兩種方式拆成模組：一種依處理步驟，另一種依最可能變動的設計決策，且皆隱藏於介面之後。唯有第二種做法，讓一次變動僅觸及一個模組，而無需任何人閱讀其餘部分。
parnas-module-decomposition.coda: 模組邊界最終編碼了對未來維護者需要知道什麼的猜測。

karen-sparck-jones-idf.title: 無人道謝的公式
karen-sparck-jones-idf.body: 1972 年，Spärck Jones 發表一篇論文，提出詞彙在文件集合中的稀有度可衡量其重要性——逆向文件頻率，如今幾乎所有搜尋引擎的排序邏輯皆基於此。她直到 1993 年才在劍橋大學獲得永久職位。
karen-sparck-jones-idf.coda: 在此之前，她一直從事一系列短期、軟性資金合約。

cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.title: 網際網路的第五人
cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.body: 1972 年，Louis Pouzin 在法國建構 CYCLADES 網路，這是第一個讓端點主機而非網路負責可靠傳輸的系統。1974 年，Cerf 與 Kahn 的 TCP 論文指名感謝他。2004 年，Cerf 與 Kahn 獲得圖靈獎。Pouzin 的名字不在其上。
cyclades-pouzin-tcpip.coda: 《經濟學人》後來稱他為網際網路的第五人。

ethernet-1973-memo.title: 以太網備忘錄
ethernet-1973-memo.body: 1973 年 5 月 22 日，Robert Metcalfe 撰寫一份標題為「Ether Acquisition」的 Xerox PARC 備忘錄，附有一張手繪圖，展示一條共享電纜連接 Alto 電腦。該技術通常被追溯至 1976 年的期刊論文。實際草圖早三年，且為手繪。
ethernet-1973-memo.coda: 論文發表時，Ethernet 已在 PARC 內部運行三年。

vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.title: 信封背面
vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.body: 網際網路的創始傳說稱 Cerf 在餐巾紙上畫出閘道架構。他已更正此事：「實際上不是餐巾紙，而是信封背面。」1973 年，他在飯店大廳等待時，畫出了後來成為 TCP/IP 閘道設計的草圖。
vint-cerf-envelope-sketch.coda: 隔年，該草圖成為 IEEE Transactions on Communications 的一篇論文。

gchq-nonsecret-encryption.title: 未發表的密鑰
gchq-nonsecret-encryption.body: 1973 年 9 月，22 歲的 Clifford Cocks 剛到 GCHQ，在半小時內推導出一種無需共享密鑰的加密方案。三年後，Diffie、Hellman 與 Merkle 在美國發表了相同構想，並被認定為發明人。GCHQ 檔案直到 1997 年才解密。
gchq-nonsecret-encryption.coda: James Ellis 於 1997 年去世，距解密將其名字載入紀錄僅數月。

kodak-digital-camera-1975.title: 柯達被埋沒的相機
kodak-digital-camera-1975.body: 1975 年，24 歲的工程師 Steven Sasson 造出第一台數位相機：重 8 磅，每張拍攝需 23 秒。高層認為，當印刷便宜且已運作一個世紀時，沒人會想在電視上看照片。他們為相機申請專利並將其擱置。
kodak-digital-camera-1975.coda: 柯達於 2012 年申請破產保護。

galls-law-origin.title: 一本關於官僚機構的書
galls-law-origin.body: 1975 年，在被 30 家出版社拒絕後，小兒科醫生 John Gall 自費出版《Systemantics》：一個運作的複雜系統必然由一個運作的簡單系統演化而來，而從頭建構的複雜系統永遠無法運作。他寫的是醫院與政府機構。
galls-law-origin.coda: 軟體架構師保留了這句話，並悄悄丟棄了它所描述的官僚機構。

ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.title: Olsen 的家用電腦
ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.body: 1977 年，DEC 創辦人 Ken Olsen 表示個人沒有理由在家中擁有一台電腦。他指的是控制家庭燈光、暖氣與娛樂的一台中央機器，就他所描述的事物而言是準確的。報導只保留了這句話的前半段。
ken-olsen-home-computer-1977.coda: Olsen 本人當時家中就有一台電腦。

kernighans-debugging-law.title: 比撰寫它難兩倍
kernighans-debugging-law.body: 在 1978 年的《Elements of Programming Style》中，Kernighan 與 Plauger 寫道，除錯比撰寫程式難兩倍，因此盡可能聰明地撰寫程式，按定義就意味著你不夠聰明到能除錯它。一條以限制你再次面對自己作品為表述的風格規則。
kernighans-debugging-law.coda: 對手從來不是別人，而是幾週後的你自己。

xerox-parc-1979-visit.title: 施樂自己的交易
xerox-parc-1979-visit.body: 1979 年 12 月：在施樂同意以每股 10 美元購買 10 萬股蘋果上市前股份以換取參觀權後，蘋果參觀了施樂 PARC。喬布斯看到 Alto 的圖形介面，稱之為他見過最好的東西。流行的說法是竊取；紀錄是一筆施樂談判的交易。
xerox-parc-1979-visit.coda: 施樂拿到了它的股份。Alto 從未作為商業產品出售。

visicalc-1979-no-patent.title: 他們跳過的專利
visicalc-1979-no-patent.body: 在 VisiCalc 1979 年發布之前，Dan Bricklin 諮詢了一位專利律師，律師根據當時的規則將成功機率定為大約十分之一。他們改為申請版權和商標。1983 年，Lotus 1-2-3 發布了一個相容介面，可以讀取 VisiCalc 自己的檔案。
visicalc-1979-no-patent.coda: 試算表作為一個類別存活下來。建立它的公司沒有。

ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.title: IBM 留了一扇門
ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.body: IBM 於 1980 年 11 月 6 日與微軟就 PC 的作業系統簽約。在一個持續十多年的反壟斷案件深處，IBM 選擇不控制其供應商，並讓微軟向任何人轉售 DOS。作為對另一場訴訟的對沖，當時這是有道理的。
ibm-microsoft-dos-1980.coda: 複製製造商在幾年內跟隨，IBM 從未重新控制該平台。

postel-law-robustness-reversal.title: 穩健性原則，被顛覆
postel-law-robustness-reversal.body: RFC 761（1980）敦促實施者在接收時寬容，在發送時保守。2023 年，IETF 自己的架構委員會在 RFC 9413 中顛覆了該指引：寬容讓錯誤固化為事實標準，使系統更不穩健，而非更穩健。
postel-law-robustness-reversal.coda: 告訴網際網路要寬容的標準被其自己的保管者廢止。

end-to-end-argument.title: 為笨網路辯護
end-to-end-argument.body: 1981 年，Saltzer、Reed 和 Clark 論證，檢查傳輸檔案的錯誤只能在兩個端點正確完成；網路可以協助但永遠無法完全取代。一篇關於在哪裡放置校驗和的論文成為保持網路簡單的奠基案例。
end-to-end-argument.coda: 一篇關於錯誤檢查放置的註記成長為網路中立性的案例。

excel-1900-leap-year.title: 未曾存在的閏年
excel-1900-leap-year.body: Lotus 1-2-3 將 1900 年視為閏年，這是一個無害的捷徑。Microsoft 為了相容性複製了同樣的錯誤日期。Lotus 已消失；錯誤的閏日仍然存在，如今已寫入 Office Open XML 規範。
excel-1900-leap-year.coda: 針對已停產競爭對手的相容性權宜之計，如今已成書面標準。

avatar-before-snow-crash.title: 小說之前的化身
avatar-before-snow-crash.body: Neal Stephenson 1992 年的小說 Snow Crash 通常被認為賦予了「avatar」的線上含義。但 Lucasfilm 的 Habitat 自 1985 年起在 Commodore 64 上運行，早已寫道：「玩家由我們稱為 Avatars 的動畫圖像代表」，源自梵語的化身之意。
avatar-before-snow-crash.coda: 該詞在書籍出版前七年已於商業服務中啟用。

radia-perlman-algorhyme.title: 演算法詩
radia-perlman-algorhyme.body: 1985 年，Perlman 在 DEC 的經理於星期五指派了無環橋接問題，隨後消失了一週。她在星期三前完成了生成樹演算法——並將剩餘時間用來撰寫 Algorhyme，一首後來成為論文摘要的詩。
radia-perlman-algorhyme.coda: 寫詩所花時間比寫演算法更長。

brooks-no-silver-bullet.title: 沒有銀彈
brooks-no-silver-bullet.body: 在 1986 年 IFIP 大會上，Fred Brooks 將軟體難度分為本質複雜度與偶然複雜度。他表示，偶然難度已大幅下降，但沒有任何單一技術能在十年內帶來十倍生產力提升。
brooks-no-silver-bullet.coda: 四十年後，每個新範式仍被宣稱為他稱不存在的銀彈。

tz-olson-database.title: Olson 資料庫
tz-olson-database.body: 大多數裝置根據一套志工維護的檔案集來解析時區，非正式地稱為 Olson 資料庫，以創始人 Arthur David Olson 命名。其命名方案歸功於 Paul Eggert，他自 2005 年起實際編輯該資料庫。
tz-olson-database.coda: 冠名者與自那時起維護它的人是不同的人。

china-1987-first-email.title: Beyond the Wall
china-1987-first-email.body: Retellings credit Qian Tianbai alone with China's first email, 'Across the Great Wall we can reach every corner of the world.' Qian was studying in the US that month; it was typed by Li Chengjiong and Karlsruhe's Werner Zorn, and left China six days later, on September 20.
china-1987-first-email.coda: His obituaries still list him as the sender.

barbara-liskov-substitution-property.title: The Law She Never Named
barbara-liskov-substitution-property.body: In a 1987 OOPSLA keynote, Barbara Liskov proposed that if substituting an object of type S for type T left every program's behavior unchanged, S was a subtype of T. She called it a substitution property. Years later, Robert Martin folded it into SOLID and named it after her.
barbara-liskov-substitution-property.coda: The word 'principle' was someone else's addition.

go-corporation-pen-computing.title: The Tablet Nobody Bought
go-corporation-pen-computing.body: In 1987 Jerry Kaplan started GO Corporation to build the pen-based PenPoint operating system, raising $75 million. AT&T acquired GO in January 1994, cancelled its supporting chip line two weeks later, and GO closed that July. Kaplan later said the company had "no meaningful sales."
go-corporation-pen-computing.coda: In 2010 Apple released the iPad, a capacitive multitouch tablet.

iso8601-unify-then-fork.title: ISO 8601's Narrower Stand-in
iso8601-unify-then-fork.body: ISO 8601 was first published in 1988, unifying five earlier, conflicting ISO date-and-time standards into one. But the format most internet software validates against is RFC 3339 (1997), a narrower profile that, after ISO 8601's later revision, is not even a strict subset of it.
iso8601-unify-then-fork.coda: The standard everyone cites and the dialect everyone's code checks against are not the same document.

python-christmas-project.title: A Christmas Hobby
python-christmas-project.body: During the Christmas holidays of 1989, with his office closed for the week, a researcher in Amsterdam looked for a hobby programming project. He began writing an interpreter for a new scripting language and named it after a comedy troupe, not the snake.
python-christmas-project.coda: In July 2026 it ranked first on the TIOBE index of programming language popularity.

worse-is-better.title: Worse Is Better
worse-is-better.body: In 1989 Richard Gabriel coined 'worse is better': a simple, half-right implementation survives better than a complete, correct one, which is why he thought C and Unix beat Lisp. In 1991 he published a rebuttal under the pseudonym Nickieben Bourbaki, posing as an old friend.
worse-is-better.coda: Decades later he still said he could not decide whether his own argument was right.

rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.title: The Protocol Someone Actually Flew
rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.body: David Waitzman published RFC 1149 on April Fools' Day, 1990: a spec for carrying IP datagrams by pigeon. On April 28, 2001, the Bergen Linux User Group actually built it, launching nine ping packets over roughly 5 km. Four came back — a 55% loss rate, round trips running 53 to 106 minutes.
rfc1149-avian-carriers-test.coda: The joke RFC has a real packet-loss figure on record: 55 percent.

att-1990-break-statement.title: The Misplaced Break
att-1990-break-statement.body: A recovery routine on a New York 4ESS switch held a break statement nested one level too shallow, a defect testing never exercised. A restart's routine "ready" signal was then misread by neighboring switches as an error, and the false alarm cascaded through the network for nine hours.
att-1990-break-statement.coda: AT&T later put the lost revenue at sixty million dollars.

aspec-vs-musicam.title: Losing to the Simpler One
aspec-vs-musicam.body: In 1991, MPEG tested two rival audio codecs. ASPEC, built by Fraunhofer, AT&T and France's CNET, won the quality tests but was ruled too complex. MUSICAM, from Matsushita and Philips, won on simplicity. The finished MP3 folded ASPEC's filter design back in anyway.
aspec-vs-musicam.coda: The format everyone calls MP3 carries the losing proposal's engineering inside the winning one's name.

linux-minix-post.title: A Post to comp.os.minix
linux-minix-post.body: On August 25, 1991, a Helsinki university student posted to the comp.os.minix newsgroup that he was writing a free operating system, calling it "just a hobby, won't be big and professional like gnu," and asked what features people wanted.
linux-minix-post.coda: Since November 2017, all 500 of the world's fastest supercomputers have run an OS built on it.

web-vs-gopher-1991.title: Free Beat Priced
web-vs-gopher-1991.body: In 1991, Tim Berners-Lee released the World Wide Web from CERN. That same year, the University of Minnesota released Gopher, for a time the more popular system. In February 1993, Minnesota announced licensing fees for Gopher servers. That April, CERN made the web protocol free.
web-vs-gopher-1991.coda: Gopher had the bigger following before the fee announcement, and never had it again afterward.

rough-consensus-running-code.title: Rough Consensus, Running Code
rough-consensus-running-code.body: At the July 1992 IETF meeting, MIT's Dave Clark put up a slide: 'We reject kings, presidents and voting. We believe in rough consensus and running code.' The phrase now anchors internet-governance folklore. It began as a jab at OSI's formal committee voting process.
rough-consensus-running-code.coda: The joke slide about OSI's voting rules became internet governance's founding creed.

han-unification-japanese-delegate.title: Han Unification's Unlikely Author
han-unification-japanese-delegate.body: In 1992 the CJK Joint Research Group merged tens of thousands of Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters into shared Unicode code points. Popular retellings cast Japan as the objector. Unicode's own history credits the verification rules to Japanese delegate Miyazawa Akira.
han-unification-japanese-delegate.coda: The delegation cast as the victim helped write the rules it is remembered for opposing.

china-first-internet-line.title: The Line a Year Early
china-first-internet-line.body: China marks April 20, 1994 as the day it joined the global internet — a 64K line, full-function access. Thirteen months earlier, physicists at IHEP had already leased a line to Stanford's SLAC, exchanging email with dozens of institutions. It just wasn't the kind of line anyone counted.
china-first-internet-line.coda: Two lines exist; only one gets an anniversary.

wiki-the-airport-shuttle.title: Named After a Shuttle Bus
wiki-the-airport-shuttle.body: "Wiki" is Hawaiian for "quick." In 1995, Ward Cunningham needed a name for the first editable web system he built and reached not for any technical term but for his memory of the Wiki Wiki Shuttle, the free bus between terminals at Honolulu's airport.
wiki-the-airport-shuttle.coda: The word's first home was painted on the side of an airport bus.

robots-exclusion-rfc9309.title: robots.txt: 28 Years Unratified
robots-exclusion-rfc9309.body: Martijn Koster proposed robots.txt in 1994; crawlers followed it voluntarily, with no formal standard and nothing to enforce it. Google proposed standardization in 2019, and the IETF finally published RFC 9309 in September 2022, closing a 28-year gap.
robots-exclusion-rfc9309.coda: The web's most-obeyed gentleman's agreement took twenty-eight years to become a real standard.

pentium-fdiv-writeoff.title: The Missing Table Entries
pentium-fdiv-writeoff.body: Mathematician Thomas Nicely noticed his new Pentium returning slightly wrong results while summing reciprocals of primes, and traced the fault to the chip itself. Intel first offered replacements only to customers who complained, and reversed into a full recall only under public pressure.
pentium-fdiv-writeoff.coda: Intel booked a $475 million pretax charge for the recall.

general-magic-private-network.title: General Magic's Private Wire
general-magic-private-network.body: In 1990 ex-Apple engineers Bill Atkinson, Andy Hertzfeld and Marc Porat founded General Magic. Sony's Magic Link shipped in 1994 for $800, sending email and running apps. Leadership built a proprietary AT&T network instead of using the internet, calling the web "passive."
general-magic-private-network.coda: Employee Tony Fadell later led hardware development on the iPod and iPhone at Apple.

ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.title: Simon's Fax Machine
ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.body: On August 16, 1994, IBM and BellSouth launched the Simon Personal Communicator: a 4.5-inch touchscreen that sent email and fax, priced at $899. Battery life ran about an hour. It was discontinued six months later, having sold roughly 50,000 units.
ibm-simon-first-touchscreen.coda: In 2007 Apple shipped the iPhone, a capacitive touchscreen phone with no physical keyboard.

cors-same-origin-orphaned.title: CORS: A Recommendation in Retirement
cors-same-origin-orphaned.body: Netscape bolted the same-origin policy onto Navigator in 1995, alongside JavaScript, with no standards process at all. CORS, meant to formally relax that policy, only became a W3C Recommendation in 2014 — and by 2020 the W3C had retired it, handing the spec to WHATWG's Fetch document.
cors-same-origin-orphaned.coda: The standards body retired its own security recommendation six years after publishing it.

php-resume-counter.title: A Résumé Hit Counter
php-resume-counter.body: In 1994, a programmer wrote a handful of small CGI programs in C for no larger reason than wanting to know how many people were looking at his online résumé. He called the toolkit "Personal Home Page Tools" and released the source in June 1995.
php-resume-counter.coda: Three decades on, over 70% of websites with a known server-side language still run its descendant.

craigslist-email-list.title: A Mailing List of Events
craigslist-email-list.body: In 1995, a software engineer in San Francisco started compiling the local gatherings and events he knew about into an email and sending it to a few friends, mainly so people could get to know one another a little better.
craigslist-email-list.coda: The list now reaches 570 cities in 70 countries and draws over 140 million visits a month.

wirths-law-misattributed.title: The Law He Credited Away
wirths-law-misattributed.body: In 1995 Niklaus Wirth published 'A Plea for Lean Software,' writing that software is getting slower more rapidly than hardware is getting faster. The line later christened Wirth's Law was, by his own footnote, a quotation of his colleague Martin Reiser.
wirths-law-misattributed.coda: The eponym cited the source; posterity kept only the eponym.

general-magic-weekend-site.title: The Site He Wasn't Serious About
general-magic-weekend-site.body: In the mid-1990s, at a Silicon Valley startup expected to reinvent handheld computing, one programmer spent his spare time writing a scrappy little site for selling secondhand junk. It went up on a weekend. He wasn't taking it seriously.
general-magic-weekend-site.coda: The startup was General Magic. The site was later renamed eBay.

gettickcount-776-day-bug.title: A 776-Day Debt
gettickcount-776-day-bug.body: Windows 95's GetTickCount rolls to zero every 49.7 days, documented behavior, never treated as a bug. But on Windows 8 through Server 2019, the same function could roll over early, near 776 days, a genuine defect. Microsoft fixed it only in Windows 11, version 24H2.
gettickcount-776-day-bug.coda: The fix landed three decades after the counter it patches first shipped.

bluetooth-the-placeholder.title: The Codename That Stuck
bluetooth-the-placeholder.body: In 1996, Intel's Jim Kardach proposed "Bluetooth" — after Harald Bluetooth, the Viking king who united Scandinavia — as a throwaway codename during Ericsson-Nokia talks. The intended replacement, RadioWire, could not clear trademark search before launch.
bluetooth-the-placeholder.coda: No replacement name ever made it to market.

chinaren-detour.title: The Off-Roster Coder
chinaren-detour.body: In 1996 a Chinese student won gold at the Informatics Olympiad and was admitted straight into Tsinghua's computer science program. As a student he moonlighted building a content system for an alumnus's website. Sohu bought it the next year; he stayed on and kept working there.
chinaren-detour.coda: The student was Wang Xiaochuan. In 2004, inside Sohu, he built Sogou.

google-a-typo.title: A Misspelled Domain Search
google-a-typo.body: During a September 1997 brainstorm, Sean Anderson suggested "googolplex"; Larry Page shortened it to "googol." Checking the domain registry on the spot, Anderson typed "google" by mistake and found it unclaimed. Page registered google.com that same day.
google-a-typo.coda: The registration record still carries the misspelling, dated September 15, 1997.

rfc2119-must-should.title: MUST vs must: A Twenty-Year Gap
rfc2119-must-should.body: RFC 2119 (March 1997) defined MUST, SHOULD, MAY and their negatives as binding requirement levels for IETF documents. But it only said these words 'are often capitalized' — lowercase must and should were never excluded. RFC 8174 patched the loophole in 2017: only all-caps counts.
rfc2119-must-should.coda: For twenty years, a lowercase must carried the same legal weight as a shrug.

netease-license-mail-1997.title: Sell the license first
netease-license-mail-1997.body: On June 11, 1997, William Ding registered NetEase in Guangzhou. The company's first business was not free webmail. It licensed a piece of email server software it had built to other websites for a fee.
netease-license-mail-1997.coda: NetEase did not launch its own free email, under 163.com, until 1998.

lixiang-graphics-card-home.title: Graphics Card Home
lixiang-graphics-card-home.body: In 1998, a high school student in Hebei started a personal website called Graphics Card Home in his spare time, posting reviews of computer graphics cards. Two years later he renamed it PCPop and kept updating it through the rest of school.
lixiang-graphics-card-home.coda: In 2005 the same person founded Autohome.

china-oicq-to-qq.title: From OICQ to QQ
china-oicq-to-qq.body: Tencent launched OICQ in February 1999 — the O stood for 'Open,' a nod to ICQ. That October, AOL, ICQ's owner, sent a cease-and-desist over trademark infringement. In November 2000, Ma Huateng renamed it QQ, chosen because the letter reads as 'cute' in Chinese.
china-oicq-to-qq.coda: Open was the first word to go once AOL's lawyers arrived.

excite-google-1999.title: Excite Turns Down Google
excite-google-1999.body: In 1999 Google offered to sell itself to Excite for $750,000 plus roughly 1% equity. CEO George Bell judged the search gap too small to justify tearing out Excite's technology. The reasoning held up. Google was worth over a billion within a year.
excite-google-1999.coda: Bell has said since that he would make the same call again.

mars-climate-orbiter-units.title: Pound-Force, Newton
mars-climate-orbiter-units.body: Mars Climate Orbiter went silent during orbital insertion. The board found that the contractor's thruster software output impulse in pound-force seconds while navigation software expected newton-seconds, off by a factor of 4.45. The craft was steered to within roughly 57 km of the surface.
mars-climate-orbiter-units.coda: The $327.6 million mission never transmitted again.

paypal-palm-beaming.title: The Beam That Never Came
paypal-palm-beaming.body: In 1999 Confinity launched infrared cash transfers between Palm Pilots, demoed live at a funding event. Weeks after launch it had roughly 13,000 users, a number that barely moved over the following year. What actually took off was email payments, built only as a fallback option.
paypal-palm-beaming.coda: The company renamed itself PayPal and quietly dropped the beam.

cai-500-yuan.title: The 500-Yuan Salary
cai-500-yuan.body: In 1999 a Hong Kong investment executive traveled to Hangzhou to assess a small website as a possible investment. He found a dozen-odd people coding in one crowded apartment. He didn't invest — he quit his $700,000 salary and joined instead, for 500 yuan a month.
cai-500-yuan.coda: His name was Joe Tsai. He later became Alibaba's executive vice chairman.

gps-week-rollover.title: GPS Week 1024
gps-week-rollover.body: GPS counts weeks in 10 bits, a field that maxes at 1,023 and rolls to zero roughly every 19.7 years. The first rollover hit in August 1999. The second landed on 6 April 2019, breaking receivers built as if the first had been a one-off.
gps-week-rollover.coda: The same overflow is on a schedule and due to recur again in 2038.

foxmail-resold.title: Sold With the Software
foxmail-resold.body: In 1994 a programmer in Guangzhou wrote a free email client in his spare time. In 2000, as the dot-com bubble burst, he sold it to a company and stayed on as tech director. Five years later that company folded and sold the software — and him with it — to Tencent.
foxmail-resold.coda: The programmer was Zhang Xiaolong. Five years after that, inside Tencent, he built WeChat.

danger-duarte-android-reunion.title: Design Director, Failed Startup
danger-duarte-android-reunion.body: In 2000 a designer joined a handheld-device startup founded by Andy Rubin, working on its interface. The company was sold to Microsoft and the team scattered. The designer went on to two other companies over the next decade.
danger-duarte-android-reunion.coda: The designer was Matias Duarte. Ten years later Rubin hired him onto Android.

slashdot-ipod-2001.title: No Wireless, Less Space
slashdot-ipod-2001.body: When Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, Slashdot founder Rob "CmdrTaco" Malda wrote in his editor's note: "No wireless. Less space than a nomad. Lame." Against the spec sheets of rival MP3 players at the time, the line was not factually wrong.
slashdot-ipod-2001.coda: The comment is now cited routinely as the counterexample it produced.

discuz-shenyang-dorm.title: CDB, a dorm build
discuz-shenyang-dorm.body: In 2001, a university student living in a dormitory in Shenyang wrote a piece of forum software and named it Crossday Bulletin, working on it alongside his coursework. The following October he renamed it Discuz.
discuz-shenyang-dorm.coda: On August 23, 2010, Tencent acquired the company he had built around it.

wikipedia-side-wiki.title: A Side Project Next to Nupedia
wikipedia-side-wiki.body: On January 10, 2001, the founder of a peer-reviewed online encyclopedia installed wiki software on the project's own server, mainly so volunteers could try drafting entries loosely on the side while the reviewed encyclopedia moved slowly ahead.
wikipedia-side-wiki.coda: By July 2026 its English edition alone held over 7.2 million articles.

bittorrent-mailing-list.title: A New P2P App
bittorrent-mailing-list.body: On July 2, 2001, a programmer posted a message to a Yahoo eGroups mailing list titled "BitTorrent -- a new P2P app," describing a file-distribution protocol he had just finished designing, one that pulled pieces of a file from many sources at once.
bittorrent-mailing-list.coda: Three years later it accounted for a third of all internet traffic, per a 2004 CacheLogic study.

webvan-thirty-minute-window.title: The Thirty-Minute Window
webvan-thirty-minute-window.body: In 1996 Borders bookstore co-founder Louis Borders started Webvan, promising 30-minute delivery on warehouses built from scratch. It IPO'd in November 1999 for $375 million at a valuation over $4.8 billion, then filed for bankruptcy in July 2001, having lost more than $800 million.
webvan-thirty-minute-window.coda: Some Webvan executives went on to Amazon; Amazon Fresh and Instacart later filled the same order.

kozmo-free-hour-delivery.title: The Free-Hour Promise
kozmo-free-hour-delivery.body: In 1998 Joseph Park and Yong Kang founded Kozmo.com, promising free one-hour delivery with couriers dispatched by pager. It raised roughly $250 million but earned $3.5 million against a $26.3 million loss in 1999. In April 2001, staff learned of the shutdown by finding closed offices.
kozmo-free-hour-delivery.coda: DoorDash, founded in 2013, dispatches couriers by smartphone GPS and charges a delivery fee.

flooz-digital-currency.title: Money With No Store
flooz-digital-currency.body: In February 1999, iVillage co-founder Robert Levitan launched Flooz.com, a digital currency users could buy and spend at partner merchants. A crime ring used stolen cards to mint $300,000 in fraudulent credits, and by 2001 fraud reached 19% of volume. The company folded that August.
flooz-digital-currency.coda: In January 2009, Satoshi Nakamoto mined bitcoin's genesis block.

yahoo-google-2002.title: Yahoo Passes on Google
yahoo-google-2002.body: In 2002 Yahoo CEO Terry Semel offered $3 billion for Google; Page and Brin held out for $5 billion. Semel's read was that Yahoo's own market cap, near $5 billion after the crash, could not absorb that bet. Google went public two years later at $23 billion.
yahoo-google-2002.coda: Yahoo sold its core business to Verizon in 2017 for $4.48 billion.

pplive-dorm-2002.title: Building 26, Yunyuan
pplive-dorm-2002.body: During the 2002 World Cup, Yao Xin's dorm at Huazhong University of Science and Technology had no television, so he watched matches over the campus network, which kept crashing. In his room in Building 26 he started working out how to combine peer-to-peer transfer with streaming video.
pplive-dorm-2002.coda: PPLive launched in 2005 and, at its peak, counted over a hundred million users.

china-alipay-escrow.title: The Escrow Workaround
china-alipay-escrow.body: In 2003, with Taobao buyers and sellers unwilling to trust each other first, finance built an escrow workaround: payment sat frozen until goods were confirmed. The first trade closed that October — a student in Xi'an paying a seller in Japan. The name puns 'pay' and 'guarantee.'
china-alipay-escrow.coda: The pun became the company's permanent, official name.

china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.title: Three Years Free
china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.body: In 2003, eBay's Eachnet held over 70 percent of China's C2C market, charging listing and transaction fees. Taobao launched that May to a near-empty site; Alibaba's answer was three years of free listings. By 2006, Taobao held 70 percent and eBay withdrew from Chinese C2C.
china-taobao-free-vs-ebay.coda: The side still charging listing fees ran out of runway first.

dianping-zagat-notes.title: A Zagat notebook
dianping-zagat-notes.body: In 2002, Zhang Tao came back to China from the United States carrying an idea he had picked up there: the Zagat Survey, a restaurant guide built from readers' own ratings. He registered the domain zsurvey.com and set out to build a Chinese version in Shanghai.
dianping-zagat-notes.coda: Dianping, the site that grew from it, went live on April 12, 2003.

wordpress-b2-post.title: The Blogging Software Dilemma
wordpress-b2-post.body: On January 24, 2003, a university student wrote on his own blog that b2, the blogging software he used daily, had gone unmaintained for months since its lead developer disappeared. He said he wanted to fork it and asked only for a name.
wordpress-b2-post.coda: The company that grew out of that fork was valued at $7.5 billion by 2021.

2003-blackout-race-condition.title: The Alarm That Didn't Ring
2003-blackout-race-condition.body: The alarm process at an Ohio control room silently jammed: a coding error let two processes gain write access to the same data structure at once, looping forever. Operators never saw the overload warnings and failed to shed load in time. The cascade left 55 million people without power.
2003-blackout-race-condition.coda: Engineers needed eight weeks to reproduce the race condition.

aws-not-leftover-servers.title: Not the Leftover Servers
aws-not-leftover-servers.body: The common version says AWS began by reselling Amazon's idle holiday-season server capacity. Benjamin Black calls that flatly false: in 2003 he and Chris Pinkham wrote a memo proposing standardized, automated infrastructure, purpose-built from the start to be sold externally as a service.
aws-not-leftover-servers.coda: S3 and EC2 launched in 2006, following that memo.

maps-intern-friendfeed.title: The Maps Team Intern
maps-intern-friendfeed.body: In 2003 a Google product manager hired an intern onto the team building local search, the project that grew into Google Maps. Four years later that intern and an engineer who had built Gmail left Google together to start a company.
maps-intern-friendfeed.coda: The intern was Bret Taylor. The company he left to start was bought by Facebook.

friendster-forty-second-load.title: The Forty-Second Load
friendster-forty-second-load.body: Friendster launched in 2002 and reached over 100 million registered accounts, but its servers buckled under the load of computing degrees of connection between friends; a single page could take forty seconds to load. Support emails show users threatening to defect to the newer MySpace.
friendster-forty-second-load.coda: Facebook launched in 2004 on the same social-graph idea and held under the traffic.

shopify-snowdevil-software.title: The Store Software Outgrew the Store
shopify-snowdevil-software.body: In 2004, programmer Tobias Lutke found the e-commerce software of the day too clunky, so he wrote his own to sell snowboard gear online as Snowdevil. Snowdevil itself stayed a small shop, but other merchants started asking to license the software behind it.
shopify-snowdevil-software.coda: Shopify listed on the New York Stock Exchange in 2015.

twitter-odeo-podcast-pivot.title: The Podcast Company's Side Project
twitter-odeo-podcast-pivot.body: On June 28, 2005, Apple built podcast subscriptions into iTunes; within two days subscriptions passed one million, and Odeo's entire podcasting business went obsolete overnight. The next March, an internal hackathon produced Jack Dorsey's SMS status-update pitch: Twitter.
twitter-odeo-podcast-pivot.coda: Odeo, the company Twitter was built inside, was sold off in 2007.

youtube-tune-in-hook-up.title: The Domain Registered on Valentine's Day
youtube-tune-in-hook-up.body: youtube.com was registered on February 14, 2005, and its founders later told of a dating-site concept modeled on Hot or Not. Jawed Karim denied attending the dinner party the story hinges on, and Steve Chen conceded it reads like a marketing narrative.
youtube-tune-in-hook-up.coda: What Karim cited instead was trouble finding tsunami footage online.

duan-buffett-lunch.title: The Buffett Lunch
duan-buffett-lunch.body: In 2006 a Guangdong electronics manufacturer won the annual charity auction for lunch with Warren Buffett, paying $620,100. He brought along a 26-year-old who had just quit an American company and had no clear plan yet.
duan-buffett-lunch.coda: The manufacturer was Duan Yongping. The young man was Colin Huang, who later founded Pinduoduo.

blackberry-iphone-2007.title: BlackBerry Saw the Flaws
blackberry-iphone-2007.body: In January 2007, BlackBerry co-CEO Jim Balsillie and chairman Mike Lazaridis watched the iPhone unveiling. Lazaridis's list of flaws was accurate: no physical keyboard, weak security, poor battery, glass typing. Every item was real. Balsillie's reply was, "It's OK, we'll be fine."
blackberry-iphone-2007.coda: BlackBerry's market share eroded to the iPhone in the years that followed.

dvorak-iphone-2007.title: Dvorak Says Pull the Plug
dvorak-iphone-2007.body: On March 28, 2007, columnist John C. Dvorak wrote that phone margins were thin and Nokia and Motorola already dominant, so Apple should hand the iPhone design to some "suckers" and walk away. Given Apple's history in that market, the reasoning was not unreasonable.
dvorak-iphone-2007.coda: He later said that once he actually held the phone, he regretted the call.

auctomatic-taggar-yc.title: The One Who Had to Learn to Code
auctomatic-taggar-yc.body: In 2007 two Irish teenage brothers brought a homemade e-commerce tool into Y Combinator and merged their company with one run by two Oxford graduates. Neither of the Oxford pair could program. One of them was told to learn, fast.
auctomatic-taggar-yc.coda: That one was Harj Taggar, later Y Combinator's first non-founder partner.

justintv-backpack-cruise.title: The Livestreaming Backpack
justintv-backpack-cruise.body: In March 2007 a man strapped a webcam to a baseball cap and began livestreaming his life around San Francisco, twenty-four hours a day, wearing a homemade laptop-backpack rig built by a friend who had dropped out of MIT.
justintv-backpack-cruise.coda: The friend who built it was Kyle Vogt, who later founded Cruise, acquired by GM for over $1 billion.

stackoverflow-blog-post.title: The Anti-Experts-Exchange
stackoverflow-blog-post.body: On April 16, 2008, a programmer posted on his own blog that he wanted to build an "anti-Experts-Exchange" question-and-answer site for programmers, without the paywalls and search-engine gaming he found nauseating about the incumbent.
stackoverflow-blog-post.coda: In 2021 the site was sold to Prosus for 1.8 billion dollars.

zune-leap-year-freeze.title: Day 366
zune-leap-year-freeze.body: Near midnight Pacific time on 31 December 2008, every Zune 30 froze solid, nicknamed Z2K9. The cause was an infinite loop in a power-chip driver that could only trigger on a leap year's 366th day. No patch existed; the only fix was letting the battery die.
zune-leap-year-freeze.coda: The remedy shipped by Microsoft was to wait for the device to run out of power.

china-wang-jian-alibaba-cloud.title: The Liar Who Built the Cloud
china-wang-jian-alibaba-cloud.body: Around 2012, with Alibaba Cloud years into heavy investment and no visible product, staff told Jack Ma directly that Wang Jian was a fraud. Close to eighty percent of the engineering team quit. Ma's reply: fund it a billion yuan a year for ten years, then judge it.
china-wang-jian-alibaba-cloud.coda: Ten years later, the fraud's project turned a profit.

taobao-double11-2009.title: 27 merchants
taobao-double11-2009.body: On November 11, 2009, Taobao Mall rounded up twenty-seven brands to fill a slow sales week; the plan had called for over thirty, but merchants kept dropping out. A civil servant named Yan Jun in Shanxi placed the day's first order, 150 yuan of phone credit, at 00:00:03.
taobao-double11-2009.coda: Sales that day reached 52 million yuan, ten times an ordinary day.

cloudflare-hbs-elective.title: An Elective at HBS
cloudflare-hbs-elective.body: In 2009 a programmer took a leave of absence to study for an MBA at Harvard Business School. He had spent years running an anti-spam volunteer project on the side. He mentioned it in class one day. A classmate said it should be a real product.
cloudflare-hbs-elective.coda: That classmate was Michelle Zatlyn, later Cloudflare's co-founder and COO.

china-3q-war.title: Choose One
china-3q-war.body: On November 3, 2010, Tencent forced a pop-up choice: uninstall 360 or QQ would stop running. Ma Huateng warned users might be wiped out within three days. Days later the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology ordered both sides to restore compatibility.
china-3q-war.coda: The regulator ended it, not the market or either company.

china-thousand-groupon-war.title: The Thousand-Groupon War
china-thousand-groupon-war.body: China's first group-buying site launched in 2010; portals and social networks piled in within months. By August 2011, more than 5,000 group-buying companies were competing — the 'Thousand-Groupon War.' By mid-2014, only 176 sites remained standing.
china-thousand-groupon-war.coda: Fewer than two hundred of five thousand survived.

semver-dependency-hell.title: SemVer's Own Exemption
semver-dependency-hell.body: In 2010 GitHub cofounder Tom Preston-Werner published semver.org, proposing MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH to end 'dependency hell.' The spec itself carves out an exception: during the 0.y.z 'initial development' phase, anything may change at any time — a stage most packages never actually leave.
semver-dependency-hell.coda: Most published packages never leave the version range the rule does not bind.

instagram-burbn-cut.title: What Got Cut From Burbn
instagram-burbn-cut.body: Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger spent nearly a year building a full-featured check-in app called Burbn, then judged their own finished iPhone build cluttered. They stripped it down to photos, comments, and likes, and shipped the result eight weeks later as Instagram.
instagram-burbn-cut.coda: Within a week of launch it had 100,000 users.

tz-database-lawsuit.title: The Lawsuit Over the Time Zone Database
tz-database-lawsuit.body: In October 2011 astrology-software maker Astrolabe sued the tz database's maintainers, claiming its zone data infringed an atlas it published. The mailing list and FTP server went dark. ICANN stepped in to host the database; Astrolabe withdrew the suit in February 2012.
tz-database-lawsuit.coda: An astrology company's copyright claim over sunrise tables was withdrawn without payment.

instagram-facebook-2012.title: A Billion for a Filter
instagram-facebook-2012.body: In April 2012 Facebook announced it was paying $1 billion for Instagram, a 13-person team with no revenue. On The Daily Show, Jon Stewart asked, "A billion dollars of money? For a thing that kind of ruins your pictures?" Measured against team size and revenue, the question was not unfair.
instagram-facebook-2012.coda: The deal is now cited routinely as one of the best acquisitions in tech history.

didi-alibaba-resignation.title: From Alibaba to taxis
didi-alibaba-resignation.body: Cheng Wei spent eight years at Alibaba, working up to deputy general manager of Alipay's consumer business. In June 2012 he quit and, with Wu Rui and Li Xiang, started a taxi-hailing app. When it launched on September 9, only sixteen drivers were online at once.
didi-alibaba-resignation.coda: Two months later, more than a hundred drivers were online at the same time.

knight-capital-power-peg.title: The Eighth Server
knight-capital-power-peg.body: Knight Capital pushed new trading code to eight servers; only seven took it. The eighth still ran dead Power Peg code, retired years earlier, which live orders woke up. In 45 minutes Knight built $3.5B long and $3.15B short. The SEC's finding: nobody reviewed the incomplete deploy.
knight-capital-power-peg.coda: Knight was acquired by a rival within a week of the loss.

dnnresearch-week-of-bidding.title: A Week of Bidding
dnnresearch-week-of-bidding.body: In 2012 a University of Toronto professor and his two graduate students crushed the field in an image-recognition contest, then incorporated a shell company to sell themselves. Google, Microsoft, Baidu, and DeepMind spent a week bidding against each other for it.
dnnresearch-week-of-bidding.coda: Hinton chose Google. One of the two students was Ilya Sutskever.

xiaohongshu-name.title: Not that little red book
xiaohongshu-name.body: Most people assume the name points at the other red book. The founder's own account is duller: Bain & Company and the Stanford Graduate School of Business, the firm he worked at and the school he attended, both run on red.
xiaohongshu-name.coda: Translated into English, the name comes out identical to the other one anyway.

china-wechat-red-envelope-pearl-harbor.title: Pearl Harbor, Digital
china-wechat-red-envelope-pearl-harbor.body: Around Chinese New Year 2014, WeChat's red-envelope feature went live; users grabbed over 40 million red packets within days. On the app Laiwang, Jack Ma called it a 'Pearl Harbor sneak attack' — effective short-term, he wrote, but healthy long-term growth mattered more.
china-wechat-red-envelope-pearl-harbor.coda: The red envelope became a payments funnel.

heartbleed-two-person-team.title: A Team of Four
heartbleed-two-person-team.body: Heartbleed's missing bounds check entered OpenSSL's heartbeat extension in December 2011 and sat unnoticed for two years until independent researchers found it in April 2014. At the time, the codebase behind most of the web's HTTPS traffic was maintained by four volunteers, one full-time.
heartbleed-two-person-team.coda: The fix shipped the same day the bug was disclosed.

goto-fail-duplicate.title: The Duplicate Jump
goto-fail-duplicate.body: Inside Apple's SSLVerifySignedServerKeyExchange, a goto fail; line was duplicated. The second copy sat outside any if, so the function always jumped past the signature check and returned success regardless.
goto-fail-duplicate.coda: The duplicate line ran unchanged on the affected systems for months.

ntp-harlan-stenn.title: Who Sets the Clock
ntp-harlan-stenn.body: Banks, exchanges and satellite systems synchronize against NTP. David Mills designed the protocol; the reference implementation is now led, largely alone, by Harlan Stenn. In March 2015 trade press ran the headline 'NTP Needs Money: Is A Foundation The Answer?'
ntp-harlan-stenn.coda: The foundation is still fundraising toward its budget.

alphago-lee-sedol-2016.title: Stone One Hundred and Two
alphago-lee-sedol-2016.body: AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol four games to one in Seoul in March 2016; Lee's only win came in game four. Afterward he said he had made a critical error early in game one, calling the computer's play there excellent and one move unlike anything a human player would choose.
alphago-lee-sedol-2016.coda: The move he singled out kept only a stone number, no name.

aws-s3-2017-typo.title: One Wide Argument
aws-s3-2017-typo.body: An S3 engineer ran an authorized command meant to take a small number of billing servers offline, but one input covered a wider range than intended. The removed servers also backed the index subsystem, which had not been fully restarted in years and came back far slower than expected.
aws-s3-2017-typo.coda: The outage ran roughly four hours; AWS's own status page depended on the same systems.

gitlab-2017-rm-rf.title: Five Backups, Zero
gitlab-2017-rm-rf.body: An engineer meant to clear a lagging replica but deleted the PostgreSQL data directory on the primary instead, stopping seconds too late; roughly 300GB was already gone. GitLab found that of five backup and replication methods it had running, none could actually restore the data.
gitlab-2017-rm-rf.coda: Recovery relied on a snapshot someone happened to take six hours earlier.

attention-title-beatles-2017.title: A Title Borrowed From the Beatles
attention-title-beatles-2017.body: Eight Google researchers published "Attention Is All You Need" in June 2017; the title nods to the Beatles song "All You Need Is Love." The paper's stated aim was a sequence model for machine translation that dropped recurrent networks in favor of attention alone.
attention-title-beatles-2017.coda: All eight authors have since left Google.

cloudflare-2019-regex.title: The Fuse That Was Removed
cloudflare-2019-regex.body: A new WAF rule with a catastrophically backtracking regex pushed CPU on Cloudflare's global network to near 100 percent within seconds of deployment. The rule itself was ordinary; what let it detonate was a CPU-usage safeguard on regex rules quietly deleted weeks earlier in a refactor.
cloudflare-2019-regex.coda: The outage lasted 27 minutes and ended when the WAF was disabled globally.

requests-kenneth-reitz.title: Handing Over the Keys
requests-kenneth-reitz.body: Requests logs over 30 million downloads a month and became the standard HTTP client for Python. Kenneth Reitz released it on February 14, 2011. In 2019, after health problems, he handed control of the project to the Python Software Foundation.
requests-kenneth-reitz.coda: He has not returned to lead the project since stepping down.

linux-y2038-kernel-fix.title: Eighteen Years Early
linux-y2038-kernel-fix.body: 32-bit Unix systems will overflow their time_t counter on 19 January 2038. Linux 5.6, released in 2020, was the first kernel able to keep a 32-bit system running past that date. Applications still need a rebuild against a 64-bit time_t to actually benefit.
linux-y2038-kernel-fix.coda: The kernel was patched years before most 32-bit userspace caught up.

log4shell-eight-years.title: Eight Years Unread
log4shell-eight-years.body: Log4j sits inside most enterprise Java software; Wiz and EY found 93 percent of cloud environments exposed to Log4Shell. The flaw existed in the code since 2013. It was reported November 24, 2021 and disclosed publicly on December 10, rated CVSS 10.
log4shell-eight-years.coda: A handful of volunteers wrote the fix that reached millions of servers.

core-js-denis-pushkarev.title: The Patch Nobody Replaced
core-js-denis-pushkarev.body: core-js ships inside WhatsApp, Netflix, Apple and PayPal, logging roughly 250 million downloads a month. Its author, Denis Pushkarev, was in a fatal 2019 car accident, served about ten months in prison starting January 2020, and kept maintaining the library throughout.
core-js-denis-pushkarev.coda: Monthly donations fell from about 2,500 dollars to 400.

tesla-westinghouse-royalty.title: The Royalty Tesla Waived
tesla-westinghouse-royalty.body: Westinghouse's contract paid Tesla $2.50 per horsepower in royalties. In early 1891, with the company close to failure, Tesla released it from the royalty clause.
tesla-westinghouse-royalty.coda: In 1897 Westinghouse bought his patents outright for $216,000.

salk-polio-patent.title: The Sun Has No Patent
salk-polio-patent.body: Edward Murrow asked who owned the polio vaccine patent. Salk answered there was none, could you patent the sun. Foundation lawyers had already examined the question and found the vaccine lacked patentable novelty because of prior art.
salk-polio-patent.coda: The unpatented vaccine was later valued at seven billion dollars.

cobol-two-hundred-billion-lines.title: Two Hundred Billion Lines
cobol-two-hundred-billion-lines.body: By 1997 Gartner estimated 200 billion lines of COBOL running eighty percent of business programs worldwide. In 2020, as COVID-era unemployment claims surged, several US state governments publicly appealed for COBOL programmers to keep their decades-old benefits systems running.
cobol-two-hundred-billion-lines.coda: Six years have passed since that appeal.

sabre-sage-to-booking.title: From Radar to Reservations
sabre-sage-to-booking.body: American Airlines and IBM signed their partnership in 1957, adapting the Air Force's Cold War SAGE air-defense architecture into a booking system. SABRE ran its first online test in 1960 and launched fully in 1964, becoming the world's first online transaction processing system.
sabre-sage-to-booking.coda: The parent company still operates, more than sixty years later.

kay-objects-messaging.title: Objects, Not the Point
kay-objects-messaging.body: By 1967 Alan Kay was using "object-oriented" for a design built on cells or network nodes talking only through messages. He later wrote he was sorry he ever coined the term "objects," because it draws attention to the lesser idea and buries the one he meant: messaging.
kay-objects-messaging.coda: The word he regretted outlived the idea he meant it to carry.

voyager-68-kilobits.title: Around the broken chip
voyager-68-kilobits.body: Voyager 1 launched in September 1977. Forty-seven years out, a memory chip in its flight data subsystem failed, three percent of it corrupted beyond repair. On 20 April 2024 engineers rearranged the code around the damaged area and the signal came back.
voyager-68-kilobits.coda: Its generators may supply enough power to return engineering data until 2036.

gif-lzw-unisys.title: The Free Format That Wasn't
gif-lzw-unisys.body: CompuServe shipped GIF in June 1987 using LZW compression without realizing Sperry Corporation already held the patent on it. In December 1994 Unisys, formed from Sperry's merger, announced it would collect licensing fees, prompting developers to build PNG as a replacement.
gif-lzw-unisys.coda: The patents ran out worldwide in 2004, and only then was GIF free.

zimmermann-pgp-release.title: PGP Given Away, Then Investigated
zimmermann-pgp-release.body: Phil Zimmermann released PGP with its source code on public FTP in 1991, the first widely available public-key encryption program. US Customs opened a criminal investigation for export-control violations. It ran three years and was dropped without indictment in early 1996.
zimmermann-pgp-release.coda: Three years under investigation, no charges filed, no royalties ever collected.

json-good-not-evil.title: For Good, Not Evil
json-good-not-evil.body: Douglas Crockford's 2002 license for the JSON libraries adds one clause: the software shall be used for Good, not Evil. JSON itself spread free and unpatented into nearly every API on the internet, but that single sentence made the license incompatible with standard open-source terms.
json-good-not-evil.coda: The format became universal; the joke clause it shipped with did not survive contact with corporate legal.

sogou-movie-line.title: Sogou's Line Was a Joke First
sogou-movie-line.body: The 2001 comedy Big Shot's Funeral has a wordplay line about search engines: "They search Sohu, we search Sogou, everyone searches their own way." Three years later, in 2004, Sohu's team took the joke and launched it as a real search engine, Sogou.
sogou-movie-line.coda: The punchline became the product name, unedited.

tbl-double-slash.title: The Extra Slashes
tbl-double-slash.body: Tim Berners-Lee put "//" in front of the domain name when he designed the URL. In October 2009 he admitted, given the colon already there, the two slashes were not needed at all — "it seemed like a good idea at the time," he said.
tbl-double-slash.coda: Every URL since has still typed both of them.

bilibili-mikufans.title: Bilibili's First Name Was Mikufans
bilibili-mikufans.body: The site launched in June 2009 as Mikufans, built for fans of the vocaloid Hatsune Miku. In January 2010 it was renamed Bilibili, after a nickname the protagonist of a light novel series gives Misaka Mikoto — an onomatopoeia for electric discharge.
bilibili-mikufans.coda: The renamed site kept the name through every subsequent redesign.

kuaishou-gif-app.title: Kuaishou Began as a GIF App
kuaishou-gif-app.body: Kuaishou launched in March 2011 as GIF Kuaishou, a phone app for making and sharing GIF images. In 2012 it pivoted to short video, and in 2014 the GIF prefix was dropped, leaving the name it carries as a video platform today.
kuaishou-gif-app.coda: The GIF prefix is gone; the underlying company name never changed.

zhihu-invite-only.title: Zhihu Needed an Invitation
zhihu-invite-only.body: Zhihu went live on January 26, 2011, and for its first two years registration required an invitation code. Open sign-up did not arrive until March 2013. The name itself is classical Chinese for "do you know" — a question, not a slogan.
zhihu-invite-only.coda: Registration has required no invitation since March 2013.

hp-garage-palo-alto.title: The Garage on Addison Avenue
hp-garage-palo-alto.body: In 1938 David Packard and his wife rented the ground-floor apartment of a 1905 house at 367 Addison Avenue in Palo Alto. He and Bill Hewlett put 538 dollars into the one-car garage behind it and built their first product, an audio oscillator.
hp-garage-palo-alto.coda: The property is now on the National Register of Historic Places and is not open to visitors.

apple-crist-drive-garage.title: When the bedroom ran out
apple-crist-drive-garage.body: In 1976 Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak assembled the first Apple boards at the house Jobs's parents owned in Los Altos, California.
apple-crist-drive-garage.coda: In his bedroom first. The garage only later, when there was no space left.

huawei-nanyou-flat.title: A Flat in Nanyou Xincun
huawei-nanyou-flat.body: In September 1987 Huawei was registered in a residential block in Nanyou Xincun, Shenzhen, with 21,000 yuan of capital, fourteen employees, and six shareholders splitting the equity evenly.
huawei-nanyou-flat.coda: The company moved its headquarters out in 1989; the flat's tenancy as HQ ended there.

wojcicki-garage-menlo-park.title: The Garage She Rented Out
wojcicki-garage-menlo-park.body: In September 1998 Page and Brin rented a garage in Menlo Park from Susan Wojcicki for $1,700 a month. Google was incorporated there.
wojcicki-garage-menlo-park.coda: She later became YouTube's chief executive.

tencent-seg-403.title: Building 2, Room 403
tencent-seg-403.body: In November 1998 Tencent registered at room 403, building two, of the Saige technology park in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen. The building was full of startups like it, and the door was no different from any other.
tencent-seg-403.coda: The room is kept open only to Tencent employees now, under the name Tencent Origin.

unitree-left-dji.title: Out of DJI
unitree-left-dji.body: During his master's, Wang Xingxing built an all-electric quadruped robot on his own and called it XDog. After graduating he took a job at DJI, and left it soon after.
unitree-left-dji.coda: Unitree was registered in the Binjiang district of Hangzhou in August 2016.

unitree-one-yuan-option.title: One yuan a share
unitree-one-yuan-option.body: In September 2017 Unitree signed option agreements with seventeen employees at one yuan per share. Further grants followed, held through a single employee vehicle.
unitree-one-yuan-option.coda: Eight years later the company opened the book on its IPO.

unitree-g1-price.title: Ninety-nine thousand
unitree-g1-price.body: Humanoid robots had been priced as laboratory equipment. Unitree put the G1 on sale at 99,000 yuan, roughly the price of an entry-level car.
unitree-g1-price.coda: By 2025 humanoids were 51.78 percent of its revenue, on 5,500 units shipped.
